title: Retry policy from **kwargs
hints: Start from a copy of the defaults (dict(DEFAULTS)) and .update() it with the overrides; never modify DEFAULTS itself.
set(overrides) - set(DEFAULTS) is the set of unknown keys; if it is non-empty raise TypeError mentioning one of them.
Validate after merging, because the max_delay >= base_delay rule needs both values, whichever one the caller changed.
tuple(sorted(set(retry_on))) removes duplicates, sorts, and freezes the statuses in one expression.
